results.title: Meet Gulveer Singh, the Indian who made CWG history with historic 10,000m silver
results.description: India's Gulveer Singh produced a sensational late kick and surged to a silver medal in the men's 10,000m, adding the Commonwealth Games medal to the Asian Games bronze and twin gold medals in the Asian Championships he has won so far.

results.title: Giants' Harrison Bader injured in ‘scooter accident,' will undergo MRI
results.description: Giants outfielder Harrison Bader further injured his sore left foot that has sidelined him for two months when he was involved in a scooter accident in San Francisco, the team announced.

results.title: MLB Highlights: Tigers 14, Orioles 0
results.description: Gleyber Torres and Eduardo Valencia combined for three homers and nine RBIs to lead the Detroit Tigers to a blowout 14-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles.

results.title: How Tejaswin Shankar’s inputs helped Sarvesh Kushare make history in 2026 CWG high jump for India
results.description: The high jumper picked up an injury before the event, and even after he realised he couldn’t continue any longer, he stayed put and helped Kushare win a silver.
